subject.en: A curious leaf-green mantis head with one folded paper ribbon
subject.zh: 好奇的叶绿螳螂头像，搭配一条折纸彩带

context: Schema-driven CLI generation and API credential management.
moment: A mantis pauses mid-fold and tilts its triangular head toward one small folded paper ribbon held by its naturally folded foreleg.
interest: One short folded paper ribbon, with coral, golden yellow, turquoise and a restrained violet facet, beside the face.
paletteDirection: Leaf and emerald greens, pale yellow-green face planes, deep teal shadow planes; multicolor only on the single paper ribbon.

subject.en: A worldly navy-and-ivory penguin holding binoculars
subject.zh: 手持望远镜、见多识广的深蓝与象牙白企鹅

context: Chinese mutual-fund research, ranking and market dashboards.
moment: A well-travelled penguin has just lowered its binoculars and turns with a quietly observant expression.
interest: One compact binocular instrument projecting beside the upper body, with a restrained multicolored prism accent on the lens rims.
paletteDirection: Midnight navy and indigo feathers, opaque warm-ivory bib, restrained natural amber beak and feet; brass/coral/turquoise lens accents form one instrument group.

subject.en: A crafted shield behind a bow and arrow, sword and magic staff
subject.zh: 盾牌在后，弓箭、长剑与魔法杖在前的精制武器徽记

context: A nostalgic single-player 3D browser RPG with twenty classes, three realms and local saves.
moment: A compact adventurer equipment emblem turns slightly toward the light, revealing the shield and three distinct class weapons.
interest: The complete weapon assembly is the identity; physical highlights and one violet gemstone provide hierarchy without an animal-style rainbow accessory.
paletteDirection: Deep forest enamel, antique gold and steel, warm timber and leather, one restrained violet gemstone.

subject.en: A silver-blue American Shorthair head playing with one yarn loop
subject.zh: 拨弄一圈彩色毛线的银蓝美短猫头像

context: A local HTTP bridge and dashboard for Claude, Codex, Copilot, Hermes and Pi coding-agent CLIs.
moment: A curious American Shorthair catches a small yarn loop with one real paw and tilts its face toward the viewer.
interest: One compact loop of multicolored yarn beside the cheek, touched by one natural paw; no second accessory.
paletteDirection: Fresh silver-blue and slate-gray classic tabby markings, ivory muzzle, warm amber eyes; coral, golden yellow, turquoise and violet only on the yarn loop.
